subject.title: refactor(plugins): consolidate security and install regression tests

question: Should the protected maintainer-requested test consolidation proceed after an owner verifies that every former negative security and install case remains represented by the new helpers and tables?
rationale: The branch changes a large set of security-sensitive regression fixtures without runtime changes; deciding that the coverage equivalence is sufficient requires owner judgment over the intended test boundary.

options.title: Verify coverage equivalence and continue
options.body: Have the plugin-test owner compare the removed cases with the new parameterized cases and attach focused test output before normal merge review.

options.title: Split the consolidation
options.body: Separate the ClawHub trust refactor from installer and optional-tool fixture cleanup if equivalence is difficult to audit as one batch.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Close or defer the cleanup if maintaining explicit security cases is clearer than the proposed abstraction.

recommendation.title: Verify coverage equivalence and continue
recommendation.body: Have the plugin-test owner compare the removed cases with the new parameterized cases and attach focused test output before normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored the submitted consolidation and is the only identified coordination point in the supplied review evidence.
